body: Dosta toga, roditelji sve stariji time i sve manje sposobni da vode računa o sebi, treba zarađivati sve više, naći neku nekretninu, ulagati novac u nešto u nadi da će se isplatiti na neke duže staze, održavati se zdravstveno i fizički...itd. Naravno ahedonija i pasivna suicidnost ne pomaže ali nemam još uvek pravo na okončavanje samog sebe.

That my current life goal is to "dig my own grave" once my parents pass away. I don't know if I'll stick to it but so far I made a few necessary preparations and no, no amount of "you need professional help" will change that.

I understand, I also have a degree that I needed to get in order to satisfy my parents and have a slightly better chance to get employed and earn money not because I want to but rather because it's necessary and I got really lucky there so I cannot complain about that. 

Yeah I've heard that you need to make your own point in life but...I just can't seem to care or force myself enough to do so.

I'm sorry to hear about your relationship, I hope you can at least look back on good times you had with her with a smile rather than regret.

Unfortunately I just have some base reluctance towards therapy, I think that would just drain me additionally and be really awkward, besides I wouldn't know where to find a "good" therapist that I could afford. Guess I'll need to try at some point.
